name: Familiar Options
description: Choose a Tiny or Diminutive animal to serve as your familiar. Each grants a different bonus to its master while within 5 ft. (PHB 53). Master-side bonuses are NOT auto-applied — track them on your sheet manually.

options.name: Cat
options.description: Tiny feline. Master gains +3 Move Silently.

options.name: Hawk
options.description: Tiny raptor. Master gains +3 Spot in bright light.

options.name: Owl
options.description: Tiny nocturnal raptor. Master gains +3 Spot in shadowy areas.

options.name: Rat
options.description: Tiny rodent. Master gains +2 Fortitude saves.

options.name: Snake (Tiny Viper)
options.description: Tiny venomous serpent. Master gains +3 Bluff.

options.name: Weasel
options.description: Tiny mustelid. Master gains +2 Reflex saves.
